notes.title: It's the Major Quest Log Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721284/efb7a61c7f0b4849fe5f56f349a80d0cf085078e.png

The Student Disembody overwhelmingly voted for a quest tracker, and, 41 tracked quests later, I can absolutely see why! Never lose a second of storytelling and/or precious memory cells again with the Quest Log, Collectibles tracker, and an improved Journal!


MAJOR CHANGES

 Added QUEST LOG UI! Check under your JOURNAL!
 There are now 41 quests listed in the UI, and several more unlisted ones (like Crow Fighting). This is all guiding you through stuff that’s ALREADY been in the game, but now in a handy dandy easy-to-refer-to UI!
 Added COLLECTIBLES UI! Check under your JOURNAL! Keep track of your Phone Cases, Microfiche, and folks you’ve met!
 Prom tickets are now sold by Kelly!
 Kelly won’t let you go to Prom unless you pass all your Act 1 classes first! Bummer!
 Fixed Hallway Running portals in the Hex and Xerxes cutscene


MINOR CHANGES

 Added flag for having gained access to the Campus Shop
 Added Met flags for all remaining characters in-game for quest log purposes
 Fixed 2 missing Tate memories
 Fixed 3 missing Hex memories
 Updated Journal icon!
 Updated intro tutorial text!
 Added cheat code “Dropout” to automatically pass all your classes. SHHH! (A list of complete cheat codes can be found for the Free and over tiers on my Patreon!)


As always, you can report bugs in the Bugfinder General thread, or on the #bugs-bugs-bugs channel on Discord! <3333

notes.title: The Full Character Customization Update is Here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721284/7823c604e8cef895c990e150a93d843878b4483d.png

It's finally here - the fully customizable Character Creation screen! Select from over 27 (!) hairstyles, an array of body types, facial features, & skin tones, and makeup to finalize your perfect slasher-smasher. (Smash as in boink, OR literally smash - your call).

I hope you enjoy the starting selection of options! I'm SUPER pumped to have this be part of the Slasher U ecosystem! <333


MAJOR CHANGES

 Introducing CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION, including 27 (!!) new hairstyles!! (Available in the Complete Edition only!) Yup - full customization! Different body types! Hair! Skin! Face (eyes, nose, brow, mouth)! Makeup! The works!!
 New ITEMS! Black smudgy eyeliner, black eyeshadow, pink eyeshadow, black lipstick, & pale pink lip gloss!
 Removed Lisbet body type - the original intent for Lisbet was to include coiled hair, and now I’m happy to report there’s a bunch of coiled and protective hairstyles available in Character Customization!! I used the body rebuild to focus on different body sizes for this update, and Lisbet’s hair was incorporated into the Hair options!
 Added new body type - welcome Lambert to campus! :D
 Added background to Surgeon version of Character Customization
 All sweater outfits now have pants! Whoa!


MINOR CHANGES

 New UI zone (The Vat) for character creation background vibes!
 You can now update your appearance at the Surgeon as usual!
 Flash now correctly turns off when you talk to the Surgeon
 (SPOILERS) Removed requirement of making connection between Hays Society & Hays Code to trigger end-of-Act-1 Murder

notes.title: 2023 Winter Content Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721284/a046b796907edfa3343f2fe56a5e0f7691f1337e.png

SLASHER U Winter Content Update!
Hey Student Disembody!! I've got the long-awaited Truth or Dare minigame at your hands - with 45+ new unique cutscenes, dialogues, and interactions you can discover! Plus, a new category of equippables - canes, with lots of options to choose from!

There's TONS more extras I've snuck in - read on for a full list below! Thanks for making the first semester - er, half-year - of Slasher U's existence so, so, so very special! <333

MAJOR CHANGES

 TRUTH OR DARE IS HERE! Check out DIK, at day or night, any time after the SPOILERS Act 1 murder. Hint: Head to the back of the left-hand-side yard! DOUBLE HINT: You can play this minigame AS MANY TIMES as you like - there are over 45 total reactions and cutscenes with unique Truths and Dares for each character! You can read more about the three-step Truth or Dare minigame on my Patreon (each character randomly chooses their Truth or Dare victim, then the victim randomly picks Truth or Dare, playing out unique dialogue, and so on!)
 There are now CANE accessories! (5 to collect in total! - one is placed in your dorm room plus Steinfurter’s office, the other 4 can be bought from Cliff at the Campus Shop!)
 Some OUTFITS now adjust your PERSONALITY POINTS!
 Outfits are now, on the whole, a LOT cheaper!
 No more blue square over Hex’s pretty little head during the intro text for the first time you hook up with him
 Hex’s second gym cutscene is now reject-able
 The game now plonks you out onto the path outside the admin building instead of INSIDE the admin building!


MINOR CHANGES

 Fixed Archibald saying your name correctly during the Food Delivery quests
 Added hanger icons to all clothing items in their item names
 Flailing Wildly at crows during battle now requires zero energy!
 Fixed up Lloyd’s sprite so clothes fit him better (no sleeves!)
 Removed Lockpick skill from Memories (but not Stats/Personality)
 Changed End of Act 1 popup text
 Replaced box with phone case in admin building with an easier-to-see box.


As always, you can report bugs in the Bugfinder General thread, or on the #bugs-bugs-bugs channel on Discord! <3333
